lines.text: The LORD tells Ezekiel to declare the abominations of Oholah and Oholibah, who committed adultery with their idols.
They sacrificed their children in the fire to idols, then entered God's sanctuary the same day to profane it.
The sisters sent messengers for men from afar, bathed and painted their eyes for them, and set God's gold and silver on their table.
Men from the rabble put bracelets on their wrists, and wealthy men will sentence them for adultery and bloodshed.
The mob will stone them and burn their houses, and they will know He is the Lord GOD.
